description: The cases the workbench's visibility rules are held to, on the server (src/haute/_workbench_visibility.py, tests/test_workbench_visibility.py) and in the view (frontend/src/utils/sheetVisibility.ts, sheetVisibility.test.ts) alike (specs/workbench). Each case names a form, replaces the show_when of the sheets, sections and components it lists, and of the fields field_show_when lists (each a component, a table and a column, its look given that show_when), and says, for the values typed (rows by table name, cells by column name), which sheets, sections, components and input columns are hidden, and which fields hide in components that show (none where hidden_fields is left out); a section on a hidden sheet is hidden too, as is a component in a hidden section and a field of a hidden component.
